choice: Every Overpass query bbox must sit on the 0.1-degree grid and cached tiles must not be fetched again, but adjacent missing tiles may be merged into one query; the fake Overpass reads the first four comma-separated numbers in the query as south,west,north,east
options: Require exactly one request per missing tile
text: How strict should the acceptance tests be about how OverpassCameraSource splits and queries tiles?
why: The JSDoc promises grid-aligned tiles and no refetch of fresh tiles, not one request per tile; this keeps the tests from locking in one query style
